subject: Re: Demo request — Private/VPC for Covenant Health (procurement + SOC2)
messages:
From: Erin Stokes <erin.stokes@covhs.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: pmc-procurement@covhs.com, gregory.lewis@covhs.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 22:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: Private/VPC deployment for Covenant Health

Hi Jonas,

We signed up through your self-serve flow today and would like to schedule a demo focused on Private/VPC/on-prem options — we have several regulated workloads and need to understand networking, key management, and audit capabilities.

Attendees on our side: me (security lead), Gregory Lewis (infra), and the procurement mailbox (pmc-procurement@covhs.com). High-level asks:
- Overview of Private deployment topology (VPC peering, routing, egress controls)
- KMS/HSM integrations and key separation options
- Audit logs, retention, and SOC 2 evidence you can share
- Procurement / SOW / NDA process and timelines

Preferred windows (US Eastern): Aug 24 morning, Aug 25 afternoon, or Aug 26 anytime. We are on a tight timeline and would like a hands-on demo plus a short MPA (mutual action plan) to move procurement forward.

Can you confirm availability and who will join from Redwood (solutions engineer, AE, and someone who can discuss compliance)? Also, do you have SOC 2 docs we can review before the call?

Thanks,
Erin Stokes
Security Architect, Covenant Health Systems
erin.stokes@covhs.com

-----

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Stokes <erin.stokes@covhs.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request: Private/VPC deployment for Covenant Health

Hi Erin — thanks for signing up and for the clear list of requirements. Happy to run a focused session that covers topology, KMS options, and the evidence you need for procurement.

I can host the session and will bring Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineering) to handle architecture and live walkthroughs; Marissa Cole (AE) will manage procurement next steps and the MPA.

Proposed slots (all in US Eastern):
- Mon Aug 24 — 09:00–09:45 ET (short technical walkthrough + Q&A)
- Tue Aug 25 — 14:00–14:45 ET (recommended: live demo of private deployment console + network diagram)

If neither works we can do Wed Aug 26 — any time, and we can extend to 60 minutes.

I attached a short SOC 2 summary and an architecture sketch of our Private deployment so your team can skim ahead of the call. If you have an NDA/MPA draft, please send and Marissa will review.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-private-architecture.png

Next steps: tell us which slot you prefer and who should receive the calendar invite (individual emails or the procurement mailbox).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks Jonas — Tue Aug 25 at 14:00 ET works for us. Please invite the procurement mailbox (pmc-procurement@covhs.com) and cc Gregory (gregory.lewis@covhs.com).

I'll attach our standard NDA/MPA draft in a follow-up from procurement for your legal/AE review; procurement may ask for a few redlines around data handling and termination. For the demo, Gregory will want to review the network diagram in detail — he is in CDT but will join remote.

A few pre-demo requests from Security:
- Can you confirm whether logs are pushed to customer-managed SIEM or only stored in Redwood?
- What retention windows are configurable?
- Do you support bring-your-own KMS keys (AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault)?

Thanks — Erin
